sql: SELECT MIN(t.title) AS american_vhs_movie FROM company_type AS ct, info_type AS it, movie_companies AS mc, movie_info AS mi, title AS t WHERE ct.kind  = 'production companies' AND mc.note  like '%(VHS)%' and mc.note like '%(USA)%' and mc.note like '%(1994)%' AND mi.info  IN ('USA', 'America') AND t.production_year > 2010 AND t.id = mi.movie_id AND t.id = mc.movie_id AND mc.movie_id = mi.movie_id AND ct.id = mc.company_type_id AND it.id = mi.info_type_id
explain:
QUERY PLAN                                                               
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Aggregate  (cost=48399.46..48399.47 rows=1 width=32)
   ->  Nested Loop  (cost=6433.89..48399.46 rows=1 width=17)
         Join Filter: (t.id = mi.movie_id)
         ->  Nested Loop  (cost=6433.89..41161.80 rows=1 width=8)
               Join Filter: (it.id = mi.info_type_id)
               ->  Hash Join  (cost=6433.89..41158.26 rows=1 width=12)
                     Hash Cond: (mi.movie_id = mc.movie_id)
                     ->  Seq Scan on movie_info mi  (cost=0.00..34524.85 rows=53203 width=8)
                           Filter: (info = ANY ('{USA,America}'::text[]))
                     ->  Hash  (cost=6433.87..6433.87 rows=1 width=4)
                           ->  Nested Loop  (cost=0.00..6433.87 rows=1 width=4)
                                 Join Filter: (ct.id = mc.company_type_id)
                                 ->  Seq Scan on company_type ct  (cost=0.00..1.05 rows=1 width=4)
                                       Filter: ((kind)::text = 'production companies'::text)
                                 ->  Seq Scan on movie_companies mc  (cost=0.00..6432.77 rows=4 width=8)
                                       Filter: ((note ~~ '%(VHS)%'::text) AND (note ~~ '%(USA)%'::text) AND (note ~~ '%(1994)%'::text))
               ->  Seq Scan on info_type it  (cost=0.00..2.13 rows=113 width=4)
         ->  Seq Scan on title t  (cost=0.00..6756.40 rows=38501 width=21)
               Filter: (production_year > 2010)
 Optimizer: planner=Custom Hook joinorder=Dynamic Programming
